---
title: "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Extract the county precinct text files from the zip archive if not already unzipped
if (!dir.exists("data")) {
  unzip("2026-pri-outputofficial.zip", exdir = "data")
}

# Read all 67 tab-delimited county files (no header row; disable quote parsing for precinct names)
files <- list.files("data", pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
raw_results <- read_tsv(files, col_names = FALSE, quote = "", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Filter to the Republican primary for Governor and sum votes by candidate
gov_rep <- raw_results |>
  filter(X12 == "Governor", X16 == "REP") |>
  summarize(votes = sum(as.numeric(X19), na.rm = TRUE), .by = X15) |>
  rename(candidate = X15)
```

In the 2026 Florida Republican primary for Governor, 11 candidates competed across all 67 counties, with Byron Donalds and Jay Collins receiving the largest share of the vote.

```{r}
gov_rep |>
  # Order candidates from lowest to highest vote total for a readable horizontal bar chart
  mutate(candidate = fct_reorder(candidate, votes)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = votes, y = candidate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#b22222") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor",
    subtitle = "Official statewide vote totals by candidate",
    x = "Total Votes",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Florida Department of State (2026 Primary Official Precinct Results)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
